UC San Diego Health is proud to be a four-time Magnet-designated organization and has now earned Magnet with Distinction from the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC). Magnet is the gold standard for nursing excellence, achieved by only about 10% of hospitals worldwide. Magnet with Distinction is awarded to the highest-performing Magnet organizations, with only a select few earning this prestigious honor. This recognition reflects our commitment to transformational leadership, professional nursing excellence, innovation, exceptional patient outcomes, and an empowering practice environment where nurses thrive.

About the McGrath Outpatient Pavilion: Located in Hillcrest, the McGrath Outpatient Pavilion is a state-of-the-art, 250,000-square-foot medical facility designed to meet the growing healthcare needs of our region. Spanning six floors, this advanced facility is home to key clinical programs and offers specialized diagnostic, treatment, and procedural services. With a strong emphasis on cancer care, we are committed to delivering world-class medical services in a patient-centered environment.

Assistant Nurse Manager – Pain Management - McGrath Outpatient Pavilion SDS (Same Day Surgery)We are seeking an Assistant Nurse Manager to support the Same Day Surgery teams within the McGrath Outpatient Pavilion. This role plays a key part in ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of procedural services, while upholding the highest standards of patient care and safety.

The Assistant Manager - Pain Management supports the efficient daily operations of the procedural department by overseeing staff coordination, resource management, and compliance with safety and regulatory standards. They assist the SDS Manager in scheduling, inventory control, and workflow optimization to ensure seamless patient care and timely procedural procedures. This role involves close collaboration with surgeons, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to maintain a sterile, safe, and well-organized operating environment.

The Assistant Manager – Pain Management helps train and mentor procedural staff, monitors performance metrics, and addresses any operational challenges promptly. Strong leadership, communication skills, and a thorough understanding of procedural protocols are essential to effectively support the team and uphold the highest standards of patient safety and service quality.

Directs, advocates, and acts as resource to other members of the nursing and tech team and performs other duties a needed. Promotes compliance and support for policies and participates in patient safety and quality improvement initiatives.
While not required, a cover letter is highly recommended when applying to this position.
